title: Nubik Parkour
short: Jump on blocks like a real noob! Easy and fun!
description: Nubik Parkour is a fun 3D platformer in a blocky world for beginners. Jump across floating blocks, collect emeralds, do not fear lava — easy levels and double jump! 21 levels including the secret HACKER neon matrix. Collect coins, unlock skins and become a pro!
